scope: One physical measured-only actor memory, queried by the current robot-candidate interaction rather than summarized once identically for all candidates. Reuse the existing fusion before memory access; add no parameter, extra predictor, loss, external gate or simulator change. Compare a read-only matrix contraction with a private hypothetical update under the same architecture. Read-before-write and task-conditioned retrieval are established priors; this is a controlled mechanism test, not an earned novelty claim.
sensor: 360-degree centre-ray human-body occlusion; no range cutoff or random dropout
association: Ideal association of previously visible actors; identity is not a numeric model input
primary: Success rate in unseen 10/20-person populations, equally weighted; 5-person SR is a robustness check
checkpoint_selection: Final fixed-budget checkpoint only; IL snapshot is diagnostic
allowed_revision: Scientific hypothesis: physical actor memory can retain usable evidence while a robot-conditioned query selects decision-relevant content. Physical write input, measurement masks and clocks remain the V6 observation-clock contract. Existing fusion moves before access, with the exact same parameters. Query-read performs only qS, without committing or imagining a new actor measurement; query-branch uses the ordinary private KDA successor. Query-GRU uses a private GRU step as a matched placement control. No-history retains age/interval input and all parameter slots but zeroes committed memory. Reuse only verified V1/V3/V6 reference contracts. No tuning after outcomes; fresh confirmation retrains all eligible controls on one host. If read loses, diagnose memory dependence and learning curves before choosing any next revision.
